sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 OF 2004
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
3 OF 2004
SALARY OF JUDGES
OF SUPERIOR COURTS ORDER, 2004
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 14th December, 2004]
F.No.2(2)/2004‑Pub.,
dated 14‑12‑2004.‑‑The following Order promulgated
by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas the first paragraph of
the fifth schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
relating to the Supreme Court and High Courts provides that such higher salary
other than that specified in the said paragraph shall be paid to a Judge of the
Supreme Court or a High Court as the President may from time to time determine;
Now therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by the aforesaid paragraph the President is pleased to make
the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Salary
of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of
July, 2004.
2. Salary.--‑(1) The
salary to be paid per mensem to the Chief Justice of Pakistan shall be Rs.77220
and that to be paid to every other Judge of the Supreme Court shall be
Rs.73008.
(2) The salary to be paid per
mensem to the Chief Justice of a High Court shall be Rs.71604 and that to be
paid to every other Judge of a High Court shall be Rs.68796.
3. Repeal.--‑The
Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2003 (P.O. No.1 of 2003), is hereby
repealed.
